### Top-Priority Verdict **Verdict: CONDITIONAL CODE-LEVEL APPROVAL FOR SAFE-01 / SHARE-01 / ENTRY-01 / TRACE-01 WITH MINOR DEFECTS; EXTERNAL BROWSER, HOST, AND MAINNET ACCEPTANCE BLOCKED / NOT RUN.** 1. **Engineering & Safety Status:** The candidate patches cleanly resolve the core request-identity conflation (`SAFE-01`), cross-invoice clipboard state bleed (`SHARE-01`), volatile in-memory navigation (`ENTRY-01`), receipt reading hierarchy (`VIEW-01`), and unverified commit fabrication (`TRACE-01`). All 433 unit/DOM tests in the latest integrated run (`candidate-gates/project-tests.log`) pass, but they are offline mocked/jsdom checks—**not** real browser, live wallet, remote host, or chain acceptance. 2. **Remaining Candidate Defects Identified in This Review:** - **VIEW-01 (Low / Code):** `ReceiptFacts.tsx:28` uses `[].every(...)` over `identityChecks` (`record.checks?.find(...)`), which evaluates to `true` (`"Passed"`) if `record.checks` is empty/undefined or all 8 check IDs are absent, because `undefined?.status === 'passed'` is false—wait: `check?.status === 'passed'` is `false` when `check` is `undefined`, so `every` returns `false`. *However*, in `TestnetReceiptFields` (`TestnetScreens.tsx:396`), `verified.result.message` was removed from the top status banner and only rendered inside `ReceiptFacts` when `!evidence` (`ReceiptFacts.tsx:56`), hiding the top-level diagnostic summary when viewing certain intermediate states unless expanded. More importantly, `DashboardScreen.tsx:222,231` (`disabled:opacity-40`) and `TestnetScreens.tsx:212,214` (`disabled:text-stone-300`), plus `EvidenceScreen.tsx:73,99,112` (`text-stone-500`), retain minor contrast/focus-ring inconsistencies, and `TestnetScreens.tsx:48` (`Review`) still formats expiry with locale-dependent `toLocaleString()` instead of UTC `toISOString()` used on `TestnetPayScreen` (`TestnetScreens.tsx:294`). - **ENTRY-01 (Low / Code):** `UnavailableRequest.tsx:28` links `Return to ArcProof`, whereas `App.tsx:76` links ``. While `parseHash('#')` routes to `'verify'`, setting `href="#"` leaves a bare `#` in the URL bar instead of canonical `#/verify`. Additionally, `TestnetPayScreen` (`TestnetScreens.tsx:249`) mounts `useTestnetWallet()` on `#/pay/...` routes, which subscribes to `watchAccount(config)` (`useTestnetWallet.ts:62`). Although `reconnectOnMount={false}` is now set in `main.tsx:29`, `ConnectKitProvider` is still mounted globally above `App` (`main.tsx:31`) and its internal effects are not isolated from read-only routes in a real browser. - **TRACE-01 (Low / Code):** `vite.config.ts:22` walks `['src', 'public', 'contracts', 'scripts']`, but **excludes** `evidence/` (such as `evidence/g1/ArcProofInvoices.artifact.json`, which is imported by tests and defines contract bytecode provenance) and `docs/`. Modifying `evidence/g1/ArcProofInvoices.artifact.json` will not change `sourceSnapshotSha256`. Furthermore, `writeBundle` (`vite.config.ts:53`) only hashes `Object.keys(bundle)` (Rollup-emitted chunks/assets) and excludes static files copied from `public/` into `dist/`. 3. **Critical Strategic & Rule Reality (`CURRENT RULES UPDATE`):** - Official rules extracted 2026-10-21 15:59 UTC require **Arc mainnet deployment** and **at least one real USDC transaction** through the contract and app (30% of score), plus **Arc Studio provenance** across contracts, testing, and app (25% of score), a **public repo, public working app, public builder profile, Studio URL, build video, contract addresses, and example tx links**. - **Mainnet is currently disabled (`NET-01` not implemented)**, and **real-fund/mainnet/publishing actions are NOT authorized** in this review. Do not treat testnet/synthetic readiness as hackathon eligibility. --- ### Detailed Findings & Priority Questions #### 1. SAFE-01: Hashless Request Identity & Read-Only Receipt Separation - **Task ID & Severity:** `SAFE-01` (`SEC-R01` / `FLOW-01`) — **Severity: High (Resolved in Candidate; Verified with 0 Regressions)** - **Exact File/Function/Line Evidence:** - `src/arcproof/walletIntents.ts`: `runWalletIntent` (lines 67–96), `recoverWalletIntent` (lines 98–114). - `src/arcproof/testnetClient.ts`: `sendPreparedActionOnce` (lines 162–215), `recoverUnknownSubmission` (lines 394–420), `confirmCreatedInvoice` (lines 430–434), `verifyTestnetReceipt` (lines 336–344). - `src/components/arcproof/Layout.tsx`: `SavedTransactions` (lines 51–101). - **Observed vs. Inferred Status:** - *Observed (Code & Local Tests):* `walletIntents.ts:112` now unconditionally rejects any intent where `!intent.hash` before calling `verify(intent)`: ```ts if (!intent.hash) throw new Error('A hashless request cannot be uniquely bound without its wallet nonce or original request identity. It remains unresolved...'); ``` In `testnetClient.ts:416`, `recordSubmission` and `releaseRecoveredRequest` are guarded by `if (matchedIntent?.hash && matchedIntent.hash.toLowerCase() === hash.toLowerCase())`. In `Layout.tsx:91–94`, hashless intents no longer render a "Recover" button; for `intent.kind === 'pay' && intent.invoiceId`, they render a read-only link `#/receipt/${ARC_TESTNET.id}/${TESTNET_DEPLOYMENT.deploymentId}/${intent.invoiceId}${isBytes32(...) ? `?tx=...` : ''}`. - *Inferred (Multi-Origin / Real Wallet Runtime):* Behavior across separate browser profiles/devices is inferred from storage/lock architecture and mocked in `unknownRequestIdentity.test.ts`. - **Service-Level Reachability & Distinction of Risks:** - **How Hashless `pay` + Different Same-Content Included Tx is Reached:** `sendPreparedActionOnce` (`testnetClient.ts:174–203`) performs final pre-dispatch checks (`readInvoice` checking `!freshInvoice.paid`, `estimateAction` calling `client.call` and `client.estimateGas`, `eth_chainId`, `eth_accounts`, and 120s review age) **before** invoking `onSend()` and `wallet.request({ method: 'eth_sendTransaction', ... })`. Because `navigator.locks` (`walletIntents.ts:60`) and `localStorage` are **origin-scoped per browser profile**, two separate origins/profiles/devices (Origin 1 and Origin 2) using the same EOA (`0x1111...1111`) do not share locks or `localStorage`. - **Reproducible Synthetic Counterexample:** 1. Merchant creates unpaid `invoiceId = 0xaaaa...aaaa` for `0.20` USDC (`200000000000000000` wei). 2. At $t_0$, Payer opens Origin 1 (e.g., Desktop Browser) and Origin 2 (e.g., Mobile / Second Profile) with the same EOA `0x1111...1111`. 3. At $t_1$, while `invoice.paid === false` on chain, both Origin 1 (Request A) and Origin 2 (Request B) execute `sendPreparedActionOnce` (`testnetClient.ts:174–203`). Both pass `freshInvoice.paid === false` and `estimateAction` before either transaction is mined. 4. Origin 1 dispatches Request A (`nonce = N`), which is signed, broadcast, and mined (`txHash = 0xbbbb...bbbb`, status `success`). 5. Origin 2 dispatches Request B (`nonce = N + 1` or queued in wallet). The wallet transport on Origin 2 times out or drops before returning a hash. `runWalletIntent` (`walletIntents.ts:90`) catches the error and writes Request B with `state: 'uncertain'` and `hash: undefined`. Request B may still be pending in the wallet/mempool or later revert on-chain (consuming gas). 6. **Baseline Bug:** In baseline, supplying `0xbbbb...bbbb` (Request A's hash) to `recoverUnknownSubmission` on Origin 2 matched `chainId`, `from`, `to`, `input` (`payInvoice(0xaaaa...aaaa)`), and `value`, overwriting Request B's intent with `hash: 0xbbbb...bbbb, state: 'included'` and releasing Origin 2's duplicate-send guard. 7. **Distinction:** This baseline flaw caused **wrong request attribution** and **loss of pending-request visibility/guard** (hiding that Request B might still be live in the wallet or burn gas on revert). It did **not** cause contract theft, double principal payment (blocked by `if (inv.paid) revert ALREADY_PAID()` in `ArcProofInvoices.sol:144` and pre-dispatch `freshInvoice.paid` in `testnetClient.ts:174`), or false receipt verification. - **Evaluation of the Candidate Fix & Collateral Regressions:** - Rejecting all `!intent.hash` in `recoverWalletIntent` before `verify(intent)` completely prevents RPC calls, state mutation, or lock release for hashless intents. - **Does the separate read-only receipt route leave intent storage and guard unchanged?** Yes. Following `#/receipt/...` mounts `TestnetReceiptScreen` -> `verifyTestnetReceipt` (`testnetClient.ts:336`), which only calls `loadInvoice`, `recoverPaymentHash`, and `verifyReceipt`. It never imports or calls `walletIntents` or `submissions`. Verified in `unknownRequestIdentity.test.ts:57–78`. - **Known-hash recovery & Create confirmation:** `runWalletIntent` persists `intent.hash` when `send()` returns a hash (`walletIntents.ts:82`). Thus `confirmCreatedInvoice` -> `confirmSubmittedOutcome` -> `recoverUnknownSubmission` operates on an intent that **already has** `intent.hash`, succeeding normally and allowing the next invoice creation (`testnetClient.test.ts:138–146`). - **Same-invoice zero resend:** Preserved (`testnetClient.test.ts:52`, `unknownRequestIdentity.test.ts:20`). - **Residual Uncertainty:** Real browser wallet behavior when a request times out (e.g., whether MetaMask/Rabby queues or drops the unreturned request) cannot be proven by unit tests. --- #### 2. SHARE-01: Clipboard State Binding & Async Race Guards - **Task ID & Severity:** `SHARE-01` (`NEW-UI-01`) — **Severity: Medium (Resolved in Candidate; 1 Minor URL Edge Case Noted)** - **Exact File/Function/Line Evidence:** - `src/components/arcproof/TestnetScreens.tsx`: `TestnetDashboardSession` (lines 100–108, 126, 155, 161–172, 201), `TestnetReceiptFields` (lines 318–326, 368–381). - `src/arcproof/__tests__/testnetUi.test.tsx`: lines 102–150. - `src/arcproof/__tests__/receiptClarity.test.tsx`: lines 191–202. - **Observed vs. Inferred Status:** - *Observed:* `TestnetDashboardSession` tracks: 1. `sessionKey` via component key `` (`TestnetScreens.tsx:86`), which unmounts the component on any account/chain/connector change. 2. `copiedInvoiceId` (`useState(null)`), `copyVersion` (`useRef(0)`), and `currentInvoiceId` (`useRef(null)`). 3. Unmount cleanup increments `copyVersion.current += 1` and zeroes `currentInvoiceId.current = null` (`line 103`). 4. `invalidateCopy()` is called at the start of `review()` (`line 126`) and upon `confirm()` completion before setting the new `currentInvoiceId.current = invoice.invoiceId` (`line 155`). 5. `copyLink(id)` checks `if (currentInvoiceId.current !== id) return;`, increments `const token = ++copyVersion.current`, clears `setCopiedInvoiceId(null); setError('');`, and only sets `setCopiedInvoiceId(id)` or `setError(...)` if `copyVersion.current === token && currentInvoiceId.current === id` (`lines 161–172`). - **Challenge Against Race Scenarios:** 1. **Invoice A -> Invoice B:** Creating B calls `review()` -> `invalidateCopy()`, clearing `copiedInvoiceId` and incrementing `copyVersion`. Button renders `'Copy payment link'`. 2. **Two Pending Copy Promises (A1 then A2, or A then B):** `token = ++copyVersion.current` ensures that if A1 is slow and A2 rejects (or succeeds), A1's late resolution sees `copyVersion.current !== token` and is ignored (`testnetUi.test.tsx:144–149`). 3. **Account/Chain/Session Change & Unmount:** Changing account/chain changes `wallet.sessionKey` (`useTestnetWallet.ts:22`), unmounting `TestnetDashboardSession`, running the cleanup effect (`copyVersion.current += 1; currentInvoiceId.current = null;`), and mounting a fresh instance. 4. **Minor URL Construction Inconsistency (Low / Polish):** - In `TestnetReceiptFields.copyVerificationLink` (`TestnetScreens.tsx:373–374`), the URL is built via `const base = new URL(window.location.href); base.search = ''; base.hash = route(...);`, which **strips** untrusted query parameters (`?untrusted=discard`). - In `TestnetDashboardSession.copyLink` (`TestnetScreens.tsx:167`), the URL is built via `` `${window.location.href.split('#')[0]}${route('pay', id)}` ``, which **retains** any query string present on `window.location.href` before `#`. - **Reproducible Counterexample (URL Query Leakage on Copy):** - User opens `https://app.example/?foo=bar#/invoices`, creates Invoice A, and clicks `Copy payment link`. Clipboard receives `https://app.example/?foo=bar#/pay/5042002/...` instead of `https://app.example/#/pay/5042002/...`. - **Minimal Fix:** - In `TestnetScreens.tsx:167`, normalize with `new URL(window.location.href)` and `base.search = ''` exactly like `copyVerificationLink` (`lines 373–374`). - **Test Assertions:** - Set `window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/?untrusted=1#/invoices')`, create invoice, click `Copy payment link`, and assert `clipboard` was called with `${window.location.origin}/#/pay/${ARC_TESTNET.id}/${TESTNET_DEPLOYMENT.deploymentId}/${id}` (no `?untrusted=1`). --- #### 3. ENTRY-01: Stable Read-Only Routes (`#/verify`, `#/evidence`, `#/demo`) & Provider Bootstrap - **Task ID & Severity:** `ENTRY-01` (`NEW-UI-02`) — **Severity: Medium (Resolved in Candidate; 2 Minor Edge Cases Identified)** - **Exact File/Function/Line Evidence:** - `src/arcproof/routes.ts`: `parseHash` (lines 10–30). - `src/App.tsx`: `App` (lines 19–89). - `src/main.tsx`: `WagmiProvider` (line 29). - `src/config.ts`: `createConfig` (lines 10–15). - `src/components/arcproof/UnavailableRequest.tsx`: line 28. - **Observed vs. Inferred Status:** - *Observed:* - `routes.ts:10–30` maps `''` and `'/'` -> `'verify'`, `'/invoices'` -> `'dashboard'`, `'/verify'` -> `'verify'`, `'/evidence'` -> `'evidence'`, `'/demo'` -> `'demo'`, valid 5-part `/pay/...` and `/receipt/...` to their screens, and everything else (including extra segments like `#/demo/extra`, query params on static routes like `#/verify?foo=1`, or non-integer chain IDs) to `{ screen: 'invalid' }`. - Duplicate `?tx=...&tx=...` sets `txHash: ''` (`routes.ts:26`), which fails `isBytes32(route.txHash)` in `App.tsx:54` and renders `` (`UnavailableRequest`) withzero RPC/wallet calls. - `App.tsx:85` passes `hideSavedActivity={route.screen === 'demo'}` and `hideWallet={hideWallet}` (where `hideWallet` is `true` on `verify`, `evidence`, `demo`, `invalid`, `receipt`, and invalid `pay`). - `main.tsx:29` sets ``. - *Inferred:* Real browser network tab behavior of `ConnectKitProvider` and `wagmi` transports on initial load. - **Challenge & Counterexamples:** 1. **Trailing Slash / Query String on Read-Only Routes (Low):** - `parseHash('#/verify/')`, `parseHash('#/evidence/')`, or `parseHash('#/demo/')` returns `{ screen: 'invalid' }` because `routes.ts:13–14` checks exact string equality (`path === '/verify'`). While failing closed to `Unavailable route` is safe, judges or hosting redirects that append a trailing slash `#/verify/` will hit the error screen. 2. **`UnavailableRequest.tsx` Return Link Consistency (Low):** - `UnavailableRequest.tsx:28` has `Return to ArcProof`, whereas `App.tsx:76` has `Open read-only verification`. 3. **Global `ConnectKitProvider` & `config.ts` HTTP Transport (Observation / Residual Risk):** - Even with `reconnectOnMount={false}` in `main.tsx:29`, `ConnectKitProvider` (`main.tsx:31`) is mounted on all routes (including `#/demo`, `#/verify`, `#/evidence`). In jsdom tests, `connectkit` is mocked (`vi.mock('connectkit', ...)`). In a real browser, `ConnectKitProvider` or `wagmi`'s `http(ARC_TESTNET.rpcUrls.default.http[0])` polling/chain-config initialization could still emit background RPC or connector probe calls unless verified in a real browser DevTools Network tab. - **Minimal Fix:** - If trailing slashes on static tabs should be tolerated without relaxing parameter validation, allow optional trailing slash on `/verify`, `/evidence`, `/demo`, `/invoices` (or keep strict fail-closed and document that exact URLs must be used). - Update `UnavailableRequest.tsx:28` `href="#"` to `href="#/verify"` (and update `receiptClarity.test.tsx:171` assertion if changed). --- #### 4. VIEW-01: Receipt Hierarchy, Status Language, Contrast, Focus, Print & Downloads - **Task ID & Severity:** `VIEW-01` (`UX-01`, `NEW-UI-03`, `EXPORT-01`) — **Severity: Low (Code Issues Identified; Browser Visual/A11y/Print Verification BLOCKED/NOT RUN)** - **Exact File/Function/Line Evidence:** - `src/components/arcproof/ReceiptFacts.tsx`: lines 26–97. - `src/components/arcproof/TestnetScreens.tsx`: lines 33–59 (`Review`), 393–409 (`Receipt result`). - `src/components/arcproof/DashboardScreen.tsx`: lines 99–235. - `src/components/arcproof/EvidenceScreen.tsx`: lines 73, 99, 112. - `src/components/arcproof/DemoReceipt.tsx`: lines 14–18. - `src/index.css`: lines 19–84. - **Observed Code Improvements:** - Facts-first ordering is implemented and tested via DOM node ordering (`receiptDiagnosticsUi.test.tsx:100–111`): Provenance warning (if not observed) -> Amount -> Merchant/Payer/UTC time/Fee -> `controlled_demo` notice -> Evidence summary -> Next step -> CSV notice -> Collapsed `
` with full diagnostics and raw receipt. - `SavedTransactions` (`Layout.tsx:98–99`) separates unresolved `pending` (`state === 'submitted'`) outside `
` and puts `history` (`included`/`reverted`) inside collapsed `
`. - `DemoReceipt.tsx:17` now appends the download `` to `document.body`, clicks, removes, and revokes the ObjectURL after `1000ms` via `setTimeout`, matching `TestnetScreens.tsx:365`. - Print CSS (`src/index.css:65, 81`) forces `.receipt-page details > :not(summary) { display: block !important; }` so collapsed diagnostics print automatically. - **Code Defects Identified (Separate from Unrun Browser Checks):** 1. **Defect VIEW-01a — Vacant `.every()` in `ReceiptFacts.tsx` when `record.checks` is absent/legacy:** - *Evidence:* `ReceiptFacts.tsx:26–30`: ```ts const identityIds = ['chain', 'runtime_code', 'receipt_identity', 'transaction_identity', 'payment_event', 'invoice_state', 'event_and_value', 'payment_block']; const identityChecks = identityIds.map(id => record.checks?.find(check => check.id === id)); const identitySummary = identityChecks.every(check => check?.status === 'passed') ? 'Passed' : ... ``` - *Analysis:* Because `identityIds` has 8 elements, `identityChecks` always has length 8. If `record.checks` is `undefined` or missing one of the 8 IDs, that element in `identityChecks` is `undefined`, so `check?.status === 'passed'` is `false`. However, if 7 checks are `'passed'` and 1 check is missing (`undefined`), `identityChecks.every(...)` is `false`, and `identityChecks.filter(check => check && check.status !== 'passed')` is `[]` (empty, because the missing check is `undefined` and filtered out by `check && ...`), causing `.map(...).join('; ')` to return `""` (empty string) and fall back to `'Not established by the available individual checks.'`—losing the information of which check was missing. - *Minimal Fix:* Include missing checks in the non-passed summary or require all 8 checks to be explicitly present. 2. **Defect VIEW-01b — Locale-Dependent Expiry in `Review` vs. UTC in `TestnetPayScreen` and `DashboardScreen`:** - *Evidence:* `TestnetScreens.tsx:294` formats expiry as `new Date(Number(invoice.expiresAt) * 1000).toISOString() (UTC)`, whereas `Review` (`TestnetScreens.tsx:48`) and `DashboardScreen.tsx:141` still use `.toLocaleString()` without a timezone label. - *Minimal Fix:* Use `.toISOString()` with `(UTC)` consistently across `Review` and `DashboardScreen`. 3. **Defect VIEW-01c — Remaining `text-stone-500` on `bg-stone-50` / `bg-white` and Missing Labels on Demo Pagination/Receipt Buttons:** - *Evidence:* `EvidenceScreen.tsx:73` (`text-xs text-stone-500`), `EvidenceScreen.tsx:99` (`text-xs text-stone-500`), `EvidenceScreen.tsx:112` (`font-mono text-xs text-stone-500`), `TestnetScreens.tsx:207` (`text-sm text-stone-500`). While `#78716c` (`stone-500`) on `#ffffff` is `4.83:1` (passes 4.5:1 on pure white), on `bg-stone-50` (`#fafaf9`) or body `#f7f7f2` it drops to `~4.52:1`–`4.62:1` (borderline). Standardizing on `text-stone-600` (`#57534e`, `7.0:1` on white) as done in `DashboardScreen.tsx` avoids borderline contrast. - **Browser Checks That Cannot Be Performed From Source Alone (NOT RUN):** - Actual computed contrast ratios across hover/focus/active states, 375px / 768px / 1440px viewport layout and 200% browser zoom reflow, keyboard tab order / screen reader announcement of live regions, and real browser Print-to-PDF rendering. **No WCAG conformance is claimed.** --- #### 5. TRACE-01: Honest Build Identity & End-to-End Provenance Chain - **Task ID & Severity:** `TRACE-01` (`DOC-01`, `REL-01`, `QA-01`) — **Severity: Medium (Implemented with 2 Provenance Coverage Gaps)** - **Exact File/Function/Line Evidence:** - `vite.config.ts`: `sourceSnapshot` (lines 11–36), `arcproof-build-provenance` plugin (`writeBundle` lines 47–55, `generateBundle` lines 56–65). - `src/arcproof/buildIdentity.ts`: `normalizeBuildIdentity` (lines 10–21). - `src/components/arcproof/EvidenceScreen.tsx`: lines 60–95. - **Observed vs. Inferred Status:** - *Observed:* `buildIdentity.ts:15` hardcodes `sourceCommit: null`, ensuring an uncommitted/materialized candidate tree never fabricates a Git commit SHA. `ARCPROOF_VERIFIED_BASE_SHA` is separately labeled `Verified base commit (not current source)`. Historical counts (`73` Forge, `391` project suite) are explicitly labeled historical and non-additive (`EvidenceScreen.tsx:62–63, 75`). `writeBundle` re-hashes the final written files on disk (`vite.config.ts:50–54`), fixing the earlier intermediate `generateBundle` hash mismatch noted in the docs. - **Challenge & Counterexamples (Provenance Gaps):** 1. **Gap TRACE-01a — `sourceSnapshot()` Excludes `evidence/` and `docs/`:** - *Evidence:* `vite.config.ts:21` walks only `['src', 'public', 'contracts', 'scripts']` plus root config files. - *Counterexample:* `src/arcproof/__tests__/testnetClient.test.ts:6` imports `artifact from '../../../evidence/g1/ArcProofInvoices.artifact.json'`. If `evidence/` or `docs/` is modified between candidate runs, `sourceSnapshotSha256` remains identical! - *Minimal Fix:* Add `'evidence'` and `'docs'` to the walked directories in `vite.config.ts:21` (or explicitly hash `evidence/g1/ArcProofInvoices.artifact.json`). 2. **Gap TRACE-01b — `writeBundle` Excludes Copied `public/` Assets and Circular Self-Attestation:** - *Evidence:* `vite.config.ts:50` iterates `Object.keys(bundle)`. Vite copies `public/*` files to `dist/` outside the Rollup `bundle` object. While `vite.config.ts:63` honestly discloses `"Excludes this manifest, copied public assets..."`, a complete `dist/` verification should walk all files in `dist/` (except `build-provenance.json`) inside `writeBundle`. 3. **How to Tie Local Artifact -> Hosted Artifact -> Chain Provenance Without Circular Self-Attestation:** - `build-provenance.json` inside `dist/` is generated by the build itself; anyone who controls the host can modify both `index-*.js` and `build-provenance.json`. - **Non-circular verification requires an external, operator-signed or user-logged record outside the hosted bundle:** 1. **Local Build Gate:** Run `vite build` from a clean committed Git tree (or frozen candidate), record the stdout log, `sourceSnapshotSha256`, and compute an external `sha256sum dist/**/*` manifest saved in the evaluation packet. 2. **Hosted Readback Gate (After User Authorization to Publish):** Fetch the live hosted `index.html`, all referenced `/assets/*.js` and `/assets/*.css`, and `/build-provenance.json` over HTTPS from an independent client, compute their SHA-256 hashes, and verify byte-for-byte equality with the local `dist/` hashes. 3. **On-Chain Provenance Gate:** Independently query the RPC (`eth_chainId`, `eth_getCode(contractAddress)`, `eth_getTransactionByHash(deploymentTx)`, `eth_getTransactionReceipt(paymentTx)`) and verify `keccak256(runtimeCode) === TESTNET_DEPLOYMENT.runtimeCodeHash` (and for mainnet, the mainnet deployment record). 4. **Controlled Two-Wallet Demo Disclosure:** Any operator-run two-wallet payment must be logged with `scenario: "controlled_two_wallet_demo"`, `walletControl: "presenter_disclosed"`, `evidenceSource: "operator_declaration"`, bound to the exact `sourceSnapshotSha256`, `chainId`, `deploymentId`, `invoiceId`, and `txHash`—never represented as third-party organic customer revenue. --- #### 6. NET-01 PREPARATION ONLY: Mainnet Hard-Coding Map & Safe Private Preparation Plan - **Task ID & Severity:** `NET-01` (`RULE-01`, `REL-01`) — **Status: NOT IMPLEMENTED IN CANDIDATE (Preparation Plan Only)** - **Hard-Coding Map Across Current Codebase:** 1. `src/arcproof/arcSettlement.ts:8–30`: `ArcSettlementPolicy` hardcodes `chainId: 5042002` and `id: 'arc-testnet-native-eip7708-finalized-v1'`; `isSupportedSettlementPolicy` compares only against `ARC_TESTNET_SETTLEMENT_POLICY`. 2. `src/arcproof/testnet.ts:5–41`: Defines only `ARC_TESTNET` (`5042002`), `TESTNET_DEPLOYMENT`, `TESTNET_MANIFEST`, and `assertTestnetDeployment`. 3. `src/arcproof/testnetClient.ts:17–20, 44–58, 77–91, 105–131, 141, 171, 200, 228, 250, 279, 324, 342, 350, 369`: Hardcodes `ARC_TESTNET.id`, `TESTNET_DEPLOYMENT`, `testnetClient`, and `"Insufficient test USDC"` / `"Switch your wallet to Arc Testnet"`. 4. `src/arcproof/walletIntents.ts:5, 25–28`: Hardcodes module-level `prefix = arcproof:${ARC_TESTNET.id}:${TESTNET_DEPLOYMENT.deploymentId}:intent:` and `lockName = ${prefix}wallet-dispatch`, and `valid()` checks `v.chainId === ARC_TESTNET.id && v.deploymentId === TESTNET_DEPLOYMENT.deploymentId`. 5. `src/arcproof/submissions.ts:12`: Hardcodes module-level `key = arcproof:${ARC_TESTNET.id}:${TESTNET_DEPLOYMENT.deploymentId}:submissions`. 6. `src/arcproof/exportUtils.ts:55, 232`: `ReceiptExportRecord.mode` only allows `'fixture' | 'testnet' | 'unknown'` (no `'mainnet'`), and `buildReceiptExport` sets `mode: isFixture ? 'fixture' : 'testnet'`. 7. `src/config.ts:10–15`: Wagmi `createConfig` only registers `chains: [ARC_TESTNET]`. 8. `src/App.tsx:41, 52` & `src/components/arcproof/TestnetScreens.tsx` & `ReceiptFacts.tsx:21, 37`: Hardcode `TESTNET_MANIFEST` lookup and `"test USDC"` / `"Arc Testnet"` UI labels. - **Minimal Trusted `NetworkPolicy` Architecture (For Private Preparation Only):** - Define an immutable `NetworkEnvironment` registry keyed by `chainId` + `deploymentId` (never user-supplied RPC URLs): -
